reason: I already check every receipt myself since I caught someone inflating them, and most of what I pay for scooters is cash to mechanics with a scribbled nota or nothing at all. I might run the free check out of curiosity, but I don't see myself paying monthly for something I already do by hand.
objection: If someone is cheating me, a bot flagging a duplicate doesn't fix it. I still have to confront the person. And the real tricks, a mechanic billing for a part he never fitted or a fuel price bumped up, look like perfectly normal receipts.
would_change_my_mind: If the free check found something real in my old chats that I had missed, like money I actually lost, I would pay to keep it running.
